parameter_semantics: call_args is always the empty object: this is one full-task policy with no caller-selected object, stage, or controller. Each binding means execute the complete drawer exchange using observed world-frame states in metres/radians.
output_semantics: Each unnormalized slot is [world-axis position offset metres (3), world TCP rotation 6D (6), gripper sign scalar (1), learned reference-frame scores (4)]. Scores choose one observed origin: dynamic drawer/blue_goal, red object, red pad, or blue object. The position target is fresh selected-origin position plus the offset; world rotation is projected by Gram-Schmidt to SO(3). Slot 0 represents t-1 and slots 1..8 represent executable t..t+7. decode_action resolves the selected origin from the fresh current observation, thresholds the gripper to +1 open or -1 close, and calls panda_kinematics.solve_ik from freshly measured arm joints. Thus translation of the selected approached object or destination translates the Cartesian target exactly; no scripted motion is added.

conversion_check.description: For an encoded demonstration slot and its pre-action observation, selecting its one-hot origin reconstructs the demonstrated commanded world TCP position and rotation before shared IK; valid 6D labels are unchanged by SO(3) projection. The independent check compares FK position in metres, rotation in radians, and thresholded gripper scalar. IK nonuniqueness is allowed and unconverged best iterates remain explicitly reported.

cut_relation: One immutable policy covers every action in each of the twelve assigned complete [0, stop) demonstrations. There are no segment cuts, overlaps, runtime policy switches, or caller-selected stages; context_start is 0 for every complete binding.
